text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on Narita Top Road's way
back to Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Huh, this aroma...
...It's coming from that shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I knew it! This aroma
smells just like the perfume Mom made for me.

text_block_list.name: Top Road's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Lemon, peppermint...
and adding some moss too... there.

text_block_list.name: Top Road's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's lovely. A refreshing, straightforward scent.
It's a perfume crafted in your image, Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, so nostalgic.
You made so many different kinds for me, matching whatever mood I was in.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Did you find something you like?
Our shop is only here for a limited time.
Please, don't miss out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Then I gotta take my time picking one!
...But it's almost time for training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's buy a scent that boosts
training efficiency!
That way, it won't matter if we're a little late!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the scent of sandalwood! It helps relieve fatigue...
Maybe I should buy some for Trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely absorbed in shopping,
Narita Top Road ended up skipping her training...
